sections.name: Food Additives
rules: Use of an additive must be technologically justified and must not present an appreciable health risk or mislead the consumer.
Under GMP, use the lowest level necessary to achieve the technological effect.
Food additives shall be of appropriate food-grade quality and comply with applicable identity/purity specifications.
Unless otherwise specified, maximum-use levels in tables are set on the final product as consumed.

Carry-over is permitted only when the additive is permitted in the raw material/ingredient, the ingredient itself does not exceed its applicable maximum, and the level carried into the final food is no greater than expected under proper technological conditions/GMP.
Carry-over is not acceptable for the listed infant/young-child food categories unless an additive provision is expressly specified.

sections.name: Standards of Additives
sections.engine_rule: Chapter 3.2 identity/purity standards qualify the additive itself. Permission to use that additive in a finished food still comes from the applicable product standard and/or Appendix A.

sections.name: Other substances for use in food products
sections.engine_rule: Apply only to the named substances, foods and conditions explicitly specified in Chapter 3.3.

sections.name: Processing Aids
sections.engine_rule: Processing aids are only permitted where expressly allowed. Product/process permissions and residual levels are resolved through the applicable processing-aid provisions and Appendix C.

sequence: Resolve finished-food standardized identity and FCS
Check the vertical product standard for explicit additive permissions, prohibitions or stricter limits
Resolve Appendix A parent-category and sub-category permissions using the hierarchy
Apply the most specific applicable category entry where the same additive appears at multiple hierarchy levels
Apply GMP Table only when the selected FCS is not listed in the Annex to GMP
Check carry-over separately from direct addition
Apply additive identity/purity requirements from Chapter 3.2
Apply applicable labelling declarations and other current FSSAI regulations
precedence: Explicit product-standard prohibition or narrower limit
Most specific Appendix A sub-category permission/limit
GMP Table permission where Annex to GMP does not exclude the FCS
Carry-over only when all Chapter 3.1 carry-over conditions are satisfied
hard_fail_conditions: Additive is not permitted by any applicable direct-addition route
Entered level exceeds the strictest applicable maximum
GMP Table is relied upon for an FCS listed in the Annex to GMP
An additive is used to disguise faulty raw material or undesirable/unhygienic practices

identity_purity_standards.name: β-Carotene

identity.solubility: Soluble in carbon disulphide, benzene and chloroform; moderately soluble in normal hexane, cyclohexane, ether, petroleum ether and oils; practically insoluble in methanol; insoluble in water.

identification: Absorption maxima of an approximately 0.2 mg/100 ml cyclohexane solution in a 1 cm cell shall be in the 456–484 mμ region.
No cis-peak in the 330–355 mμ region.
Chloroform solution with antimony trichloride gives dark blue colour with maximum absorption at 590 mμ.
With concentrated sulphuric acid, the acid layer of the specified chloroform solution turns blue.

requirements.parameter: Total combined phaeophytines and their magnesium complexes

IV.name: Ammonia Sulphite Caramel

effective_amendments.chapter_3_policy: Where Version 4 marks a highlighted provision as omitted or substituted by Amendment 84, PMSV applies the amended text from 1 February 2026 and does not enforce the superseded highlighted text.

food_colour_runtime_policy.note: Version 4 contains Amendment 84 omission/substitution markers across food-colour standards. PMSV must not carry omitted highlighted requirements into current compliance decisions.
examples_of_marked_omissions: Sunset Yellow / adjacent highlighted legacy provision
Indigo Carmine / adjacent highlighted legacy provision
Fast Green FCF highlighted legacy provision
Aluminium Lake of Sunset Yellow FCF highlighted legacy provision
food_colour_runtime_policy.fail_closed_rule: Where the exact scope of an omission marker is not machine-resolved, do not recreate the superseded requirement from older text.
